summary: Describe the proposed batch challenged, plausible failure scenarios and security/workflow limits; do not invent independent assessment.

coverage.failure-cases: Challenge partial failure, interrupted work, malformed inputs and misleading success conditions.
coverage.security-classification: Challenge every security assessment, relevant dependencies and final release candidate boundaries.
coverage.privacy-export: Challenge data/secret exposure through logs, reports, build contexts, archives and candidate inventories.
coverage.workflow-traps: Challenge every draft even beside a ready starter: sourced reasons, concrete resolution actions, routine-choice deferrals, missing prerequisites, downstream writes invalidating ancestors, review order and overbroad replans.
